race.title: ARC All Weather Bonus Is Back Handicap (Div 1)
race.verdict: On the back of a fair return to action for new connections, TEGGY LASSO is fancied to take a step forward here with a raft of engagements in the coming days perhaps a sign of intent. Twitch is an in-form rival with a good draw to exploit, while Lessay is back at a much more realistic level. TEGGY LASSO (IRE) TWITCH (NZ) LESSAY (IRE)
